name: the template unwritten is refused: its comments are not content
input:
<!-- The brief: what the unit lands and why. `mise run unit:check <n>` refuses the issue until every section below is written; a comment is not content. -->

## Sources

<!-- One line per source, marked primary (read whole, or the cited sections) or secondary: - `<library stem or design page>` — **primary**: <what it decides for this unit>. Include the vault's two listings. -->

## Readings

<!-- Mark each axis yes or no; a yes may carry its reason: `yes — <why>`. -->

| Family | Axis | Selected |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Identity | `univalent` | |
| Locality | `oracle` | |
| Locality | `descent` | |
| Place | `located` | |
| Place | `resident` | |
| Dimension | `rewriting` | |

## Concerns

<!-- The concerns from ledger/concerns.sql the unit expects to touch, or none and why. -->

## Ledger

<!-- The features-ledger rows the unit lands, changes or retires, by id, or none. -->

## The shape

<!-- New territory only: the surface spelling, the obligation stated exactly, the fallback. Delete otherwise. -->

## Try first

<!-- New territory only: the probe that settles the open question. Delete otherwise. -->

## Not in this slice

<!-- The next unit on the lane. -->
